read.title: Posting Plan for the Weekend Sale
read.text:
Our weekend sale starts on Friday at 9 a.m. Please follow this plan for Instagram and TikTok.

Wednesday: Post a teaser with a countdown sticker in Stories.
Thursday: Share a reel showing the three bundle sets.
Friday: Publish the main post. Let's lead with the discount in the first line of the caption.

Use the phrase "limited-time" only once, and always show the end date. Every post should include the sale hashtag and a link in bio.
